title: Dominance effect sizes using non-parametric estimation — d_np
text: Calculate following: stochastic difference (aka Glass rank-biserial correlation); adjusted stochastic difference (aka Goodman Kruskal's gamma); dominance (aka common language effect size); measure stochastic superiority (aka Vargha Delaney's ); adjusted dominance; generalized odds ratio; win odds. x can contain microdata certain summary statistics. x contains microdata, named list 2 elements, vector data. x contains summary statistics, data.frame 2 rows. can optionally contain variable called group, indicating name group. addition, must contain one following: Binary data. number events (k) (also called "successes") number experiments trials (n). Ordinal data. One variable possible outcome (2 outcomes). outcome variables must ordered best worst. outcome variables must contain number events outcome. Optionally, x can attribute called "meta", must named list.
